message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/lib/lwan-request.c')
text=p.read_text()
old='''    size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);
    if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr)))
        return NULL;
'''
new='''    size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);
    if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)helper->buffer->len))
        return NULL;
'''
text=text.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(text)
PY
make -C /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan -j2 >/tmp/lwan_build.log 2>&1 || (cat /tmp/lwan_build.log; exit 1)
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1169,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer);","note":"The request parser hands the attacker-controlled request bytes to the proxy-protocol parser when proxy support is enabled."},
  {"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1153,"var":"buffer","code":"switches on the first 4 bytes and dispatches to parse_proxy_protocol_v2 for the PROXY v2 signature","note":"A crafted preface selects the v2 parser and keeps the same input buffer under attacker control."},
  {"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":225,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The parser treats the start of the request buffer as a fixed-size proxy header structure."},
  {"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);","note":"The claimed header length is taken directly from attacker-controlled bytes in the header."},
  {"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":234,"var":"size check","code":"if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","note":"The incorrect bound compares against the size of the in-memory struct instead of the actual request buffer length, so oversized but still received headers can pass this check."},
  {"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":236,"var":"proxy","code":"if (LIKELY(hdr->cmd_ver == PROXY)) { ... copy src/dst addresses and ports into request->proxy; }","note":"After the weak length check, the parser reads address fields from the attacker-controlled buffer and writes them into request state, enabling an out-of-bounds read when the declared length exceeds the available bytes."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '--- build log tail ---' && tail -40 /tmp/lwan_build.log` executed with exit code 0.
